overview: Ife is a Yoruba city and sacred center whose importance extends from early urban settlement to continuing religious and royal traditions.

items.text: Approximately 1200 to 1500 was a period of flourishing sculpture in bronze, terracotta and stone. Naturalistic human forms are particularly celebrated.
Yoruba creation traditions identify Ife as a place where divine beings brought humanity into existence. This is a sacred account, not an archaeological origin claim.
Kingship at Ife became a source of legitimacy for other Yoruba royal lineages.
Ife remains an urban and religious center; a dated artistic flourishing does not mark the end of Yoruba culture.
